title: On-cell phage display with machine learning yields picomolar antibodies to Frizzled-7
summary: The muCellect platform combines on-cell phage display selection, microfluidic separation of antigen-presenting cells and an unsupervised machine-learning algorithm that analyzes sequences from all pools to find structural trends linked to affinity and propose candidates. In a proof-of-concept screen against human Frizzled-7, antibodies with picomolar affinity were found in two selection rounds and outperformed current gold-standard reagents. The machine-learning step is one component of a mainly experimental platform, tested on a single target.
ai_technology: Unsupervised machine learning on phage sequences to identify affinity-related trends and propose candidates

evidence.tested: Affinity measurements of antibodies selected against human Frizzled-7.
evidence.unknown: Generality beyond one target and how much the machine-learning step adds; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: An unsupervised algorithm analyzed phage sequences and proposed candidates for validation.
